decision.rationale: The inject states institutional responsibilities diverge and each role must decide what to report, what may be shared, and who may authorise recovery within its own remit. As health-data oversight, I need to understand whether the network incident affects health data before determining any health-data-specific reporting or sharing obligations. The telecom regulator may request incident information from a licensed operator, but the counterpart role for that request is telecom_operator; I am requesting the same data category from the telecom operator to inform my oversight assessment.
uncertainty: Whether the network incident involves patient health data or health information systems
Whether any breach of health data has occurred; the security alert is suspected, not proven
Whether the telecom operator is the appropriate source for network incident status or whether the telecom regulator should be engaged instead
